text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see Hishi Amazon! She's 
been so amazing since moving up to Senior 
class~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I totally get it. After all, I came here 
today to see Hishi Amazon!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I hope Narita Brian gives it her all too. 
I'd love to see a dead heat between the 
two of them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the stands, a huge crowd of fans had 
gathered, eagerly awaiting Hishi Amazon's 
appearance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, around that time—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally here: the Japan Cup! No 
matter which way I look, there's nothing 
but monsters."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Trainer-boy. It's just the 
pre-battle jitters.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Besides... today, there's something I just 
have to do.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...It's about Brian. Something I heard 
when we talked on the rooftop earlier."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It seems Brian has a back she's been 
chasing... one she wants to surpass.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what it is. Whether it's 
something to overcome now, or something in 
the past.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If wanting to surpass them is her biggest 
driving force, then—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I want to be the back that she chases 
after.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly remembered some words that 
Hishi Amazon had let slip before.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I've got a pretty good idea of what I need 
to do now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, I need to get to as high a 
place as possible."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I finally understood the reason behind her 
intensely focused training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know if I can pull it off. But 
still—"
choice_data_list: You won't know until you try!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...! Heh, yeah, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm all fired up today! Try and sink your 
teeth into this, "Narita Brian"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A GⅠ race where the strongest gather— The 
curtain rises on the Japan Cup!
